description: Ministry of Social Empowerment & Welfare - White Cane Rules under the Protection of the Right of Persons with Disabilities Act
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the National Council for Persons with Disabilities under the Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, establishing regulatory requirements for white cane usage and defining rights of visually impaired persons. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
